notes: Fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 (Salesforce calls it fiscal 2026; data.js fy 'Jan 2026'). Documents read on sec.gov: FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001108524-26-000060, filed March 2, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001108524-26-000085, filed April 16, 2026). Dividends include dividend equivalents, as the cash-flow line says; XBRL also carries $1,605 million of dividends and equivalents declared, but the $1,587 million paid is used. Buybacks are the $12,596 million cash-flow line for fiscal 2026; the larger March 2026 accelerated share repurchase falls in fiscal 2027. Benioff's 22,791,882 shares include 880,310 shares from options and PRSUs vesting within 60 days and 10,000,000 shares held by the Marc Benioff Fund LLC; the proxy's 2.8% uses the 818,219,088 shares outstanding at March 25, 2026, after the accelerated repurchase. Holder asOf dates are the Schedule 13G filing dates the proxy cites; it gives no event dates. The Vanguard, BlackRock and State Street figures are from 2024 filings, so their percentages are stale share counts set against the smaller 2026 share base; the proxy also notes Vanguard now reports on a disaggregated basis. Salesforce completed its acquisition of Informatica in November 2025 (fiscal 2026 business combinations, net of cash acquired: $9,268 million). GEOGRAPHY: the 10-K says Americas revenue attributed to the United States was approximately 93% in each year.
